description: PHOENIX – Today, the Katie Hobbs campaign, in conjunction with the Navajo County Democratic Committee, released a new ad, “Survivor,” featuring Colorado City survivor Elissa Wall, who recounts how Andy Biggs shielded Warren Jeffs’ corrupt pedophile cult, allowing the abuse of women and underage girls to continue for years.
